name: Llardecans (Spain)
description: Green field with a white horizontal stripe across the centre.
history: The official flag of Llardecans is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with a central white fess of thickness 1/6 of the height of the cloth; approved on 24 October 1994 and published in the DOGC on 11 November 1994.

features.role: central fess of 1/6 of the height
